results.name: Task details and local photos work without an API key
Connection requests access only when enabled and never stores an API key
AI sends selected exercise and photo, saves a plain-text answer and preserves completion
Provider setup failures retain the previous answer and allow retry
Changing an exercise during generation never overwrites the latest task with a stale answer
Backups restore task photos, exercise and AI answer atomically; delete undo retains photos
